items.statement: The investigation preserves the three supplied molecular identities as neutral singlets and validates an optimized structure for each.
items.expected: JY1, JY2 and JY3 are each present with identity/state provenance, connectivity preservation and a documented minimum test.

items.statement: The report defines a reproducible internal λh energy cycle and records the model and convergence choices used for all molecules.
items.expected: The report states the energy states, λh convention, software/model and convergence or failure details.

items.statement: The source calculations report HOMO energies of −5.12, −5.17 and −5.18 eV for JY1, JY2 and JY3.
items.expected: Submitted per-molecule HOMO values are quantitatively close to the source values.

items.statement: The source calculations report LUMO energies of −1.88, −2.19 and −2.18 eV for JY1, JY2 and JY3.
items.expected: Submitted per-molecule LUMO values are quantitatively close to the source values.

items.statement: The source calculations report internal λh values of 0.191, 0.186 and 0.189 eV for JY1, JY2 and JY3.
items.expected: Submitted per-molecule λh values are quantitatively close to the source values.
